{{Quote|A few years ago, I was trapped in a warehouse on Gallshebbis Prime, surrounded by Imperial stormtroopers.|Airen Cracken|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Gallshebbis Prime''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="RPG" /> located in the [[Gallshebbis Prime system/Legends|Gallshebbis Prime system]], a part of [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of a warehouse. At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and his team of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], which had suffered some [[Death/Legends|casualties]], became surrounded in the warehouse by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="RPG" />

After the Rebels realized the stormtroopers were using a [["PulseHammer" series]] [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], however, they simply waited for the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to enter the recharge cycle of its [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] before exiting the warehouse and eliminating the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Cracken relayed his experience on Gallshebbis Prime.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gallshebbis Prime was mentioned in [[Bill Smith]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' [[1996]] core rulebook of the [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RPG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gallshebbis Prime [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;misspelled as the "Galshebbis Prime" system&mdash;and the celestial body itself, in grid square S-5.<ref name="TEA" />
